alternatives.reason: P0 verifies what was deployed rather than owning the deploy; the operator (or a later Cloud Run adapter) deploys and records the observation with an idempotency key. This keeps the control plane out of the cloud credential path for the prototype.
Architecture §Release: digest equality is necessary, not sufficient — target, configuration, approval binding, revision and smoke are verified separately.
Roadmap DoD 8 requires a Release Bundle; the bundle gate evaluates every Change and blocks the whole release with per-Change reasons (UI-13).

architecture_impact: Adds internal/release: a Release bundles one or more Changes; the manifest carries per-Change lineage (decision, work order + hash, accepted candidate, run starter, head commit, review gate), the bound EnvironmentConfig (target_ref, required evidence, approver policy, topology version, config hash), the build evidence (image digest, source commit, included commits) and a manifest hash.

Bundle gate: every Change needs an accepted decision that is not stale, an issued Work Order, an ACCEPTED_FOR_PROMOTION candidate and the same target; the environment must be ACTIVE and not production. One failing Change blocks the whole release (no partial promotion).
Build evidence must be a sha256 digest built from a commit set covering every accepted candidate head commit; a new build after approval drops the approval.

Third human approval binds the manifest hash with a 72h expiry; approver separation refuses the run starter unless the target policy lists single-operator-controls (waiver recorded). Candidate lineage changes after approval mark it STALE.

Deployment record: every gate must PASS — approval valid and bound, digest equal, target equal, config hash equal when supplied, revision observed, smoke PASS; environment config drift after approval marks the approval STALE (UI-14). Missing evidence never promotes.
Idempotency: the same idempotency_key replays the existing result without a new attempt or receipt; a second promotion of a PROMOTED release is refused.

Release Receipt (release-receipt/v1) links transition, environment config, per-Change lineage, build, approval, deployment, smoke and evidence refs with a receipt hash. scripts/record-promotion.sh reads the live Cloud Run revision with gcloud and posts the record.
cost_assumptions: No cloud resources in this slice; the record script uses the operator's gcloud.
unknowns: No real Cloud Run deployment has been recorded yet; every deployment in evidence is a declared fixture. scripts/record-promotion.sh is UNVERIFIED against gcloud output.

An isolated prod-demo promotion (same digest, second service) is not modelled separately; it would be a second release targeting a prod-demo environment once such an environment exists in the topology.
Cloud Run revision read-back inside the service (REST) is not implemented; the operator script is the read-back path in P0.
Same persistence and actor caveats as DR-005/006/007.
acceptance_criteria: UI-12: a normal candidate is promoted with commit, digest, target, config hash, smoke and revision re-readable in the receipt.
UI-13: a bundle of two Changes with one lacking an accepted candidate is GATE_BLOCKED as a whole with per-Change reasons; approval is unavailable.
UI-14: a target configuration change after approval marks the release and approval STALE and blocks deployment recording.
Digest drift, failed smoke, missing digest, wrong build commit, expired or unbound approval each fail promotion; the same idempotency key replays; double promotion is refused.
Consumer fixtures byte-identical after the browser journey.
